_README: Addendum to planning/modality-bridge-2026-10-07-rehearsal.json, made 2026-10-07 on sapphire from a disposable worktree at main d93678303 (after the Run B branch merge, the verifier and detector temperature-fallback changes and the three added arms). All 45 passes of the seven arms ran the launcher's exact arguments plus --dry-run under scripts/bridge_dryrun_harness.py (stub client, sockets blocked); pass 1 of each arm also had its complete request file built and summarised, then deleted. 'signature_check' compares each original arm's pass-1 elided request signature with the original record; 'twin_diff' lists the request fields in which each added arm differs from its twin.
